exchange.title: DPP filings
exchange.intro: Receive prosecution files from a DPP office as sealed files, register them with the court's own number, and send the receipt back. Everything works with no internet.
exchange.identity_desc: Give the registry its identity once, as the DPP offices that file to it know it. It cannot be changed afterwards.
exchange.offices_desc: Invite an office with a file. It answers, you confirm its fingerprint by typing what it reads out, and only then can it file here.
exchange.open_file: Open a file from the office
exchange.none_offices: No office has been invited yet.
exchange.filings_desc: A filing is held here until a person reads it and registers it. Nothing enters the register by itself.
exchange.invite_saved: Invitation saved for {office}. Send it to them.
exchange.confirmed: {office} is confirmed. Send it the confirmation file.
exchange.registered_notice: Registered as {number}. Send the receipt back.

prison.title: Prisons
prison.desc: A prison invites this registry with a file. Open it, save your answer, and read the prison the code shown here so it can confirm you. Then open its confirmation. Remand and release orders can then be sent to it.
prison.contact: Who to reach at this registry
prison.open_file: Open a file from the prison
prison.none: No prison has invited this registry yet.
prison.answered_notice: Answered {prison}. Send the file back and read them the code shown.
prison.send_desc: Sends this issued order, with its signed wording, to a prison that has confirmed this registry. The prison records it and sends a receipt.
prison.none_trusted: No prison has confirmed this registry yet.

firm.title: Law firms
firm.desc: A firm invites this registry with a file. Open it, save your answer, and read the firm the code shown here so it can confirm you. Then open its confirmation. Hearing dates and order copies can then be sent to it.
firm.contact: Who to reach at this registry
firm.open_file: Open a file from the firm
firm.none: No firm has invited this registry yet.
firm.answered_notice: Answered {firm}. Send the file back and read them the code shown.
firm.send_desc: Sends this to a law firm that has confirmed this registry, as a sealed file. The firm files it against its matter and sends a receipt.
firm.none_trusted: No firm has confirmed this registry yet.
